lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam jan guramat raam bolaai ||
lines.translation: O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo sunai kahai so mukataa raam japat sohaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one is embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi mukh masatak har raam janaa bhetaai ||
lines.translation: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: darasan sa(n)t dehu kar kirapaa sabh daalad dukh lahi jaai ||2||
lines.translation: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall rid me of all poverty and pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke log raam jan neeke bhaagaheen na sukhaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu raam kahahi jan ooche nar ni(n)dak da(n)s lagaai ||3||
lines.translation: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attack and sting them. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig dhrig nar ni(n)dak jin jan nahee bhaae har ke sakhaa sakhaai ||
lines.translation: Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends and companions of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: se har ke chor vemukh mukh kaale jin gur kee paij na bhaai ||4||
lines.translation: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa daiaa kar raakhahu har jeeu ham deen teree saranaai ||
lines.translation: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa prabh mere jan naanak bakhas milaai ||5||2||
lines.translation: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and merge him with Yourself. ||5||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sakhaa saadh jan neeke tin oopar haath vataavai ||
lines.translation: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out His protecting hands above them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saadh seee prabh bhaae kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends them with Himself. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: amiu amiu har ras hai meethaa mil sa(n)t janaa mukh paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, I drink it in. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke log raam jan ootam mil ootam padavee paavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham hovat cheree daas daasan kee meraa thaakur khusee karaavai ||2||
lines.translation: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak jan sevahi se vadabhaagee rid man tan preet lagaavai ||
lines.translation: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mind and body is very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin preetee karahi bahu baataa kooR bol kooRo phal paavai ||3||
lines.translation: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa jagajeevan daate har sa(n)t pagee le paavai ||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hau kaatau kaat baadh sir raakhau jit naanak sa(n)t chaR aavai ||4||3||
lines.translation: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for the Saints to walk upon. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi vad mere jan miladiaa dhil na laaeeai ||
lines.translation: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of the Lord, without delay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jan a(n)mrit ku(n)t sar neeke vadabhaagee tit naavaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, one bathes in them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam mo kau har jan kaarai laaeeai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai pag mal mal dhoor mukh laaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash their feet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan vade vade vad ooche jo satagur mel milaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satagur jevad avar na koee mil satagur purakh dhiaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur saran pare tin paaiaa mere thaakur laaj rakhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Master saves their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ik apanai suaai aai bahahi gur aagai jiu bagul samaadh lagaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bagulaa kaag neech kee sa(n)gat jaai kara(n)g bikhoo mukh laaeeai ||
lines.translation: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is like feeding on a carcass of poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mel mel prabh sa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat ha(n)s karaaeeai ||4||4||
lines.translation: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4||
